description: This is a PHPUnit test class for testing the ProjectAPI endpoints within the OrangeHRM Time plugin. It includes setup methods, data providers, and test methods for CRUD operations on project resources via the API.

classes.name: ProjectAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the ProjectAPI endpoints in the OrangeHRM Time plugin.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by clearing entity manager.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests the creation of a project via API.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestCreate
methods.description: Provides test cases for the create project test.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests retrieving all projects via API.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests retrieving a single project via API.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetOne
methods.description: Provides test cases for getting a specific project.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating a project via API.
